ruin.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production illustration atlas for an original supernatural fantasy trading card game, Biblioteca Viva. Create ONE landscape image, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows of TWELVE equally sized square illustration panels, edge-to-edge regular grid, no gutters, no borders, no rounded corners, no text, no numbers, no watermarks. The grid must be geometrically exact: each panel is one quarter of total width and one third of total height. Requested canvas aspect ratio 4:3, preferably 2048x1536. Each panel is a distinct richly painted fantasy illustration with one readable central subject, tactile materials, confident anatomy, cinematic chiaroscuro, atmospheric depth, crisp silhouette and strong focal lighting; premium hand-painted fantasy game concept art rather than abstract icons, vector symbols or generic crystals. Original designs only; no recognizable franchise characters or proprietary card frames. Each subject remains centered with breathing room, and no subject crosses into neighboring panels. Consistent finish and medium across all panels. The last two panels are neutral ivory/brass companions, keep their colors. Subjects in exact row-major order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. a mischievous coal imp with glowing coal eyes and ragged bat wings in a ruined hearth.
2. a massive armored basalt sentinel split by glowing lava fissures.
3. a charcoal serpent coiled around a broken cathedral bell.
4. a veiled ember wraith rising from a vacant funeral pyre.
5. a towering horned cathedral demon with ruined gothic arches as armor.
6. a scarlet fissure tearing through ancient stone, sparks erupting.
7. two spectral hands binding a black ember pact above an altar.
8. an empty blazing pyre with ashes turning into ghostly birds.
9. an ornate suspended funerary censer trailing faces in red smoke.
10. a carved charcoal hourglass with molten amber grains and brass fittings.
11. an intricate clockwork beetle crawling across a parchment manuscript.
12. a graceful fox made of ivory moon-wax with a luminous candle flame tail.
Overall palette for panels 1-10: charcoal, dark crimson, molten amber and aged bronze; haunting ruined cathedral atmosphere. No text anywhere. Four columns, three rows, twelve panels, exact rectangular grid.
